note: Banks and other financial institutions pay this instead of the corporate income tax. Seen only in a search snippet of DOR Bulletin #200 (April 2025).
source_title: Indiana Department of Revenue: General Tax Information Bulletin #200 (April 2025)

label: Levied by
value: Counties, cities, towns, townships, school corporations, libraries and other local units with levy authority
note: Local tax rates follow the budgets of local taxing units; the DLGF approves them each year.
source_title: IN.gov FAQs (Department of Local Government Finance): What is the Department of Local Government Finance and what does it do?

label: State oversight
value: Indiana Department of Local Government Finance (DLGF)
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: IN.gov FAQs (Department of Local Government Finance): What is the Department of Local Government Finance and what does it do?

label: Property tax cap on homesteads
note: Circuit-breaker cap: a homestead's tax bill cannot exceed 1% of its gross assessed value (voter-approved referendum levies sit outside the caps).
source_title: IN.gov FAQs (Department of Local Government Finance): How are property taxes determined and calculated?

section: Indiana property tax: state rules: figures under review
label: Property tax caps on other property
value: 2% of gross assessed value for other residential and farmland; 3% for other real and personal property
note: Part of the Indiana Constitution since 2010 tax bills. Seen only in a search snippet of the DLGF tax-bill guide.
source_title: Indiana Department of Local Government Finance: Fact Sheet, Circuit Breaker Caps
